seo.metaDescription: Grow gourmet mushrooms at home with Centrifungal's hand-inoculated hardwood grow logs. Sustainably sourced British wood, shipped to your door. No experience needed.

blocks.heading: Grow Gourmet Mushrooms at Home
blocks.text: Hand-inoculated hardwood logs that fruit again and again. No experience needed - just mist, wait, and harvest fresh mushrooms from your kitchen counter.

blocks.heading: Our Grow Logs
blocks.intro: Each log is hand-inoculated with premium spawn and grown on sustainably sourced British hardwood.

blocks.heading: Rooted in the Forest, Made for Your Home
blocks.body:
Centrifungal started with a simple idea - that anyone should be able to grow fresh, gourmet mushrooms without a garden or any special equipment. Our logs are inoculated by hand in small batches using spawn we cultivate ourselves, then slowly colonised in controlled conditions before reaching you.

The result? Mushrooms that taste like they were foraged minutes ago.

blocks.heading: Why Centrifungal?
blocks.intro: From our woodland to your doorstep - here's what makes us different.

cards.title: Grown Locally
cards.text: Every log is produced in our woodland workshop using sustainably sourced British hardwood and spawn we cultivate in-house.

cards.title: Shipped Fast
cards.text: Orders are dispatched within 48 hours in plastic-free, compostable packaging designed to keep your log happy in transit.

cards.title: Expert Care Guides
cards.text: Every order includes access to our detailed care guides, video tutorials, and direct support from our growing team.

blocks.heading: New to Mushroom Growing?
blocks.text: Our free care guides cover everything from first misting to your fifth harvest. Written by growers, for growers.
